headline: Recommended final passage of accepting $45,180 from the U.S. Department of Justice for a police grant activity.
summary: The meeting covered one resolution, R-26-076. It recommends accepting $45,180 from the U.S. Department of Justice into a police grant activity.
decisions: Recommended final passage of Resolution R-26-076, accepting $45,180 from the U.S. Department of Justice into a police grant activity. The motion carried; the minutes give no vote count.

decision_evidence.quote: RELATIVE TO THE ACCEPTANCE OF $45,180 FROM THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE INTO POLICE GRANT ACTIVITY “2025 JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT (MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL)” ... MOTION BY ALDERMAN SENNOTT TO RECOMMEND FINAL PASSAGE MOTION CARRIED
